additionalRules: A Cirith Ungol Army must always contain Shagrat and Gorbag; Shagrat must always be your General.
Orc Warrior models can only be included in the Warband of an Orc Hero.
Uruk-hai Warrior models can only be included in the Warband of an Uruk-hai Hero.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.text: Friendly Orc models gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes if there is a friendly Uruk-hai model Engaged in the same Combat. Friendly Uruk-hai models gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes if there is a friendly Orc model Engaged in the same Combat.

specialRules.name: Rivals for Power
specialRules.text: Keep track of how many models Gorbag and Shagrat have each killed. If at any point either of them has fewer kills than the other, that model may re-roll a single D6 during a Duel Roll.

specialRules.name: Swift Hunter
specialRules.text: During the declare Heroic Actions step of the Move Phase, Shelob can choose to kill a friendly model within 1" of her - remove the chosen model as a casualty. If she does, Shelob may declare a Heroic Move for free, though she may not shout With Me as part of this Heroic Move.

specialRules.name: Hands off the shiny shirt, that's mine!
specialRules.text: During a Scenario that involves picking up and carrying Objectives, Shagrat can use this special rule at any point during his Move. If he does, he may select any friendly model within 3" that is carrying an Objective and take an Intelligence Test. If the test is passed, Shagrat immediately gains possession of that Objective, even if the Scenario would not normally allow for that Objective to be passed. Additionally, Shagrat can always carry multiple Objectives, even if the Scenario would state that models can only carry one.

specialRules.name: Cleaving Blow
specialRules.text: If this model rolls a natural 6 To Wound when making a Strike, and the Wound is successful, then the target will suffer 2 Wounds rather than 1.

specialRules.name: Orcish Brawler
specialRules.text: If Gorbag is outnumbered in a Combat, he increases his Attacks to 3 for the duration of the Combat.

specialRules.name: Adaptive Fighter
specialRules.text: If Gorbag wins a Duel Roll, then before models Back Away Gorbag may choose a single enemy model involved in the combat. The chosen model is Backed Away in a direction chosen by Gorbag. This direction may be chosen so that the model is forced to Back Away over the edge of a cliff, in which case they will suffer falling damage as normal. Once this has been resolved, other models Back Away as normal and Strikes are resolved. However, if a model has been Backed Away over the edge of a cliff as described earlier, Gorbag cannot make Strikes against that model.

specialRules.name: Whip of the Masters
specialRules.text: Whenever a friendly Hero model within 6" declares a Heroic Move, Heroic March or Heroic Shoot, roll a D6. On a 4+ the Hero does not spend the Might Point and the Heroic Action is free.

specialRules.name: Cleaving Blow
specialRules.text: If this model rolls a natural 6 To Wound when making a Strike, and the Wound is successful, then the target will suffer 2 Wounds rather than 1.

units.name: Shelob
units.keywords: SPIDER, MORDOR, HERO, INFANTRY, MONSTER, BEAST, UNIQUE

specialRules.name: Lone Hunter
specialRules.text: Shelob may never be included in another model's Warband. Additionally, Shelob can never benefit from the Heroic Actions of other models.

specialRules.name: She is always hungry
specialRules.text: At the start of her Activation, so long as she is not Engaged in Combat, Shelob can choose to kill a friendly model within 1" of her - remove the chosen model as a casualty. If she does, until the end of the turn Shelob may re-roll a single dice during any Duel Roll she participates in.

specialRules.name: She hungers for sweeter meats
specialRules.text: Shelob adds 1 to her Attacks characteristic whilst she is Engaged in Combat with an enemy Man, Elf, Dwarf or Hobbit model.

specialRules.name: Caught in a Web
specialRules.text: Instead of making Strikes, Shelob may instead choose a single enemy model that was involved in the Combat. The chosen model immediately suffers a single Strength 8 hit and, if it survives, will be subject to the Paralyse Magical Power - however, the model will not automatically recover should Shelob be removed as a casualty, leave the board or be reduced to 0 Will Points.

specialRules.name: Cleaving Blow
specialRules.text: If this model rolls a natural 6 To Wound when making a Strike, and the Wound is successful, then the target will suffer 2 Wounds rather than 1.
